spans.s: तुङ्ग तुङ्ग. See under rt. 2. तुज् next col.

तुङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, high, elevated, prominent, erect,
lofty; long; vaulted; chief, principal; strong, passionate
[cf. उत्-तुङ्ग]; (अस्), m. an elevation, height, culmina-
tion, altitude; a mountain; top, highest point, peak,
vertex; the superior apsis or aphelion of a planet; (meta-
phorically) a throne; a wise man; a rhinoceros; the
planet Mercury; the tree Rottleria Tinctoria; the
cocoa-nut; N. of a man; (आ), f., N. of a tree [cf.
शमी]; also = तुगा, bamboo manna; N. of a metre
consisting of four lines of eight syllables each; N. of
a river in the Mysore territory; (ई), f. a kind of
Ocimum (वर्वरा); turmeric; night; (अम्), n.
the stamina of the lotus blossom; [cf. Lith. tunkù,
‘to grow fat:’ Russ. tucnyĭ, ‘fat:’ Hib. tonngo, ‘a
billowy sea;’ tonnghail, tonnta, ‘waved.’]
—तुङ्ग-
कूट, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a place of
pilgrimage.
—तुङ्ग-ता, f. or तुङ्ग-त्व, अम्, n.
altitude, loftiness, height, passionateness.
—तुङ्ग-
धन्वन्, आ, m., N. of a king of Suhma.
—तुङ्ग-
नाभ, अस्, m. a particular species of poisonous
insect.
—तुङ्ग-नासिका or ई, f. a woman having a
prominent nose.
—तुङ्ग-प्रस्थ, अस्, m., N. of a
mountain.
—तुङ्ग-बल, अस्, m., N. of a warrior.
—तुङ्ग-भ, अम्, n. the lunar mansion in which
a planet reaches its apsis, the apsis of a planet.
—तुङ्ग-भद्र, अस्, m. a restive elephant or one
in rut; (आ), f., N. of a river in the Mysore territory,
commonly called Tumbudra, formed by the junction
of the Tuṅga and Bhadra rivers.
—तुङ्ग-मुख,
अस्, m. a rhinoceros, (‘having a prominent snout.’)
—तुङ्ग-वीज, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), quick-
silver, (‘forming long seed-like balls.’)
—तुङ्ग-वेणा,
f., N. of a river in the Dekha.
—तुङ्ग-शेखर,
अस्, m. the top of a mountain.
—तुङ्ग-शैल, अस्,
m. ‘the high mountain,’ N. of a mountain with a
temple of Śiva.
—तुङ्गी-नास, अस्, m. a kind of
poisonous insect.
—तुङ्गी-पति, इस्, m. the moon,
(‘lord of night.’)
—तुङ्गीश (˚गी-ईश), अस्, m. the
moon; the sun; an epithet of Śiva; N. of Kṛṣṇa.
—तुङ्गेश्वर (˚ग-ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘lord of the
mountains,’ an epithet of Śiva; a temple of Śiva;
[cf. गिरिश and गिरीश.]

तुङ्गक, अस्, m. the tree Rottleria Tinctoria;
(अम्), n., N. of a sacred forest.

तुङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, high, lofty; (ई), m. a planet
at the apex of its orbit or of its position with regard
to others considered astrologically; (इनी), f., N. of a
plant, = महा-शतावरी.
